meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能翻查你之前所有会话的存档。它会先列出带编号的搜索结果(含时间、类型、标题),再按时间线看上下文,最后只取你挑中的几条完整记录;也能用 /knowledge-agent 把历史总结成问答。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话的事,例如「我们以前解决过吗」「上次是怎么做 X 的」「上周发生了什么」等,不是当前对话时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录超时的?
say.note: 搜索跨会话记忆并给出相关记录。

say.text: 查一下上周关于 JWT 认证的记录。
say.note: 先列出带编号的搜索结果,再按时间线过滤。

say.text: 把历史里所有 bug 修复总结成问答讲给我。
say.note: 调用 /knowledge-agent 生成综合回答。

howto.what_en: Claude can look up past sessions. It lists numbered results first, adds timeline context, fetches full details only for chosen IDs, and can summarize history via /knowledge-agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we do X last time?", "what happened last week?" — not about current conversation.

say_en.text: How did we solve login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Searches memory and returns relevant records.

say_en.text: Show last week's records about JWT auth.
say_en.note: Lists numbered results, then filters by timeline.

say_en.text: Summarize all past bug fixes as Q&A for me.
